scope: checked-out bundled artifact; not verified App Store binary
method: exact lowercased surface-form membership, not decoder execution
probe_limitations: Hand-selected diagnostic probes, partly motivated by known gaps; not a representative random sample. Categories may overlap. Phrase component probes do not test phrase prediction.

esdb.note: Raw normalized source-minus-pack delta, not approved additions or evidence of usage frequency.

build_corpus.note: In-sample coverage on the pack's own Tatoeba training source, using the builder's tokenization and 128-token sentence limit; not held-out recall.

phrase_probes.note: Observed adjacent n-gram records only; absence permits backoff and does not prove prediction failure; a phrase's presence does not establish tone awareness.
